questions.q: Considering only the length within India's territory, the longest river is the
questions.e: The Ganga flows about 2,500 km, the longest stretch of any river within India. The Brahmaputra is longer overall, but most of it lies outside India. The Godavari is the longest river flowing entirely within India.

questions.q: The highest peak located entirely within India is
questions.e: Nanda Devi (7,816 m) in Uttarakhand is the highest peak lying entirely within India. Kangchenjunga (8,586 m) is higher, but it stands on the Sikkim-Nepal border.

questions.q: Which soil is best suited to the cultivation of cotton and is also called regur?
questions.e: Black (regur) soil holds moisture well and is rich in lime and iron, so it suits cotton. It is found mainly on the Deccan Plateau.

questions.q: Jim Corbett National Park, India's oldest national park, is in
questions.e: Established in 1936 as Hailey National Park, it is now Jim Corbett National Park in Uttarakhand.

questions.q: The Thar Desert lies mainly in which state?
questions.e: The Great Indian (Thar) Desert covers most of western Rajasthan and extends into parts of Gujarat, Haryana and Punjab.

questions.q: The south-west monsoon first reaches the Indian mainland at the coast of
questions.e: The monsoon normally hits Kerala around 1 June and then advances north.

questions.q: The Tropic of Cancer passes through how many Indian states?
questions.e: It passes through Gujarat, Rajasthan, Madhya Pradesh, Chhattisgarh, Jharkhand, West Bengal, Tripura and Mizoram.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. Mount Everest lies entirely within India.
II. The Tropic of Capricorn passes through India.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Everest is on the Nepal-China border, and the Tropic of Capricorn lies in the southern hemisphere. The Tropic of Cancer is the one crossing India.

questions.q: Nathu La, a major Himalayan pass for trade with China, is in the state of
questions.e: Nathu La lies on the Sikkim-Tibet border and was reopened for border trade in 2006.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. Kaziranga National Park is located in Assam.
II. Kaziranga is famous for the Asiatic lion.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Kaziranga in Assam is known for the one-horned rhinoceros. The Asiatic lion is found in Gir, Gujarat.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements (2011 Census).
I. Rajasthan is the largest state of India by area.
II. Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state of India.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Rajasthan covers about 3.42 lakh sq km, the most among the states. Uttar Pradesh is the most populous state in the 2011 Census.

questions.q: Winter rainfall in north-western India, useful for the rabi wheat crop, is brought mainly by
questions.e: Western disturbances are mid-latitude cyclonic systems from the Mediterranean region that give winter rain in Punjab, Haryana and nearby areas.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. Zoji La connects Srinagar with Leh.
II. Zoji La is located in Himachal Pradesh.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Zoji La in the Zanskar range links the Kashmir Valley with Ladakh. It is in Jammu and Kashmir, not Himachal Pradesh, where Shipki La is found.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. The Narmada flows westward through a rift valley.
II. The Narmada drains into the Bay of Bengal.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: The Narmada flows through a rift valley between the Vindhya and Satpura ranges and falls into the Arabian Sea in the Gulf of Khambhat.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. Jharia is a major coalfield in Jharkhand.
II. Most of India's coal production comes from Gondwana coalfields.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Jharia (Dhanbad district) is the best-known coalfield of Jharkhand. Gondwana coal gives the bulk of India's coal output, while Tertiary coal is small.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. Khadar is newer alluvium found in the flood plains.
II. Bhangar is older alluvium found above the flood level.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Khadar is the new alluvium deposited by floods each year, whereas bhangar is the older alluvium, rich in kankar nodules and lying on higher terraces.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. Mawsynram in Meghalaya receives one of the highest rainfalls in the world.
II. The Khasi Hills funnel moist monsoon winds there.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Mawsynram and nearby Cherrapunji are on the southern face of the Khasi Hills, whose funnel shape traps moist south-west monsoon winds.

questions.q: El Niño is generally associated with ______ in Indian summer monsoon rainfall.
questions.e: El Niño, the warming of the eastern Pacific, usually weakens the Indian monsoon and is linked with drought years.

questions.q: The Sundarbans National Park, famous for mangroves and the Royal Bengal tiger, is in
questions.e: The Sundarbans in the Ganga-Brahmaputra delta in West Bengal is a UNESCO World Heritage Site.

questions.q: Which state has the largest reserves of bauxite in India?
questions.e: Odisha holds roughly half of India's bauxite reserves, mainly in the Eastern Ghats.

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. Chilika is a freshwater lake located in Kerala.
II. Chilika is the largest coastal lagoon in India.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Chilika is a brackish water lagoon in Odisha, not a freshwater lake in Kerala. It is the largest coastal lagoon in India.

questions.q: The Bering Strait separates which two continents?
questions.e: The Bering Strait lies between Russia (Asia) and Alaska (North America).

questions.q:
Consider the following statements.
I. Laterite soil forms under heavy rainfall with alternate wet and dry seasons.
II. Laterite soil is rich in nitrogen and humus.
Which of the above is/are correct?
questions.e: Intense leaching in hot, rainy climates removes silica and nutrients, so laterite is poor in nitrogen and humus. It is suited to cashew and tapioca.

questions.q: Match the national parks with their states.
questions.e: Kanha is in Madhya Pradesh, Simlipal in Odisha, Namdapha in Arunachal Pradesh and Bandipur in Karnataka.

questions.q: Which of the following is NOT a characteristic of regur (black) soil?
questions.e: Black soil is clayey, swells when wet and cracks when dry, which makes it self-ploughing. It drains poorly and does not leach easily.

questions.q: The Bhor Ghat pass lies on the route between Mumbai and
questions.e: Bhor Ghat (Khandala) in the Western Ghats carries road and rail links between Mumbai and Pune. Thal Ghat leads to Nashik.

questions.q: When it is 12 noon in Delhi (IST, UTC+5:30), the time at Tokyo (UTC+9) is
questions.e: Tokyo is 9 - 5.5 = 3.5 hours ahead of IST, so noon in Delhi is 3:30 pm in Tokyo.

questions.q: Kalbaisakhi, the pre-monsoon thunderstorms of April-May, is mainly associated with
questions.e: Kalbaisakhi (Nor'westers) are violent evening thunderstorms with rain and hail in West Bengal, Assam and Odisha. Loo is the hot dry wind of the north-western plains.

questions.q: The Bailadila range is famous for deposits of iron ore in
questions.e: Bailadila hills in Bastar, Chhattisgarh, hold high-grade haematite iron ore, much of it exported through Visakhapatnam.

questions.q: The Equator does NOT pass through which of the following countries?
questions.e: The Equator crosses Ecuador, Colombia, Brazil, Gabon, Congo, Uganda, Kenya, Somalia and Indonesia among others. Peru lies wholly south of it.
